script_source:
#!/bin/bash
# Independent re-run of the attenuation slice's rails in the agent's worktree (warm target), final tree.
W=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/attenuation/worktree
S=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/attenuation/scratch
V=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/validation/attenuation3
R="python3 /home/brittonr/.cargo-target/mantle-complete-20261026-9ar4jfgk/run-in-worktree-v1.py --worktree $W --scratch $S --"
cd $W; git rev-parse HEAD > $V/head.txt; git status --short > $V/status-before.txt
: > $V/summary.txt
run() { name=$1; shift; echo "== $name: $*" > $V/$name.log; $R "$@" >> $V/$name.log 2>&1; echo "$name rc=$?" >> $V/summary.txt; }
run core-caveat cargo test --locked --offline -p crunch-remote-core --lib caveat -- --test-threads 1
run adapter-caveats cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle remote_build::authority_caveats -- --test-threads 1
run gateway-authority cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle nix_gateway::authority -- --test-threads 1
run store-cmd-view cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle store_cmd::tests -- --test-threads 1
run remote-attenuated cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle remote_build::tests::attenuated_admission_tests -- --test-threads 1
run remote-ticket-admission cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle remote_build::tests::production -- --test-threads 1
run remote-forged-time cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle remote_build::tests::forged_client_time_and_endpoint_cannot_expand_ticket_authority -- --exact --test-threads 1
run remote-malformed cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle remote_build::tests::malformed_request_does_not_consume_ticket -- --exact --test-threads 1
run project-selector cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle project_build -- --test-threads 1
run store-view cargo test --locked --offline -p crunch-store --lib restricted_view -- --test-threads 1
run store-capability cargo test --locked --offline -p crunch-store --lib capability::tests -- --test-threads 1
run cli-ticket-create cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --test remote_credentials_cli -- --test-threads 1
run fmt-mantle cargo fmt --check -p mantle
run fmt-store cargo fmt --check -p crunch-store
run clippy-store cargo clippy --locked --offline -p crunch-store --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings
run clippy-mantle cargo clippy --locked --offline -p mantle --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings
git status --short > $V/status-after.txt
echo ALLDONE >> $V/summary.txt

golden_recompute.script:
import re, struct, subprocess, pathlib
def b3(data): return subprocess.run(['b3sum', '--no-names'], input=data, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode().strip()
fr = lambda b: struct.pack('>Q', len(b)) + b
src = pathlib.Path('src/remote_build/attenuated_admission.rs').read_text()
tests = pathlib.Path('src/remote_build/tests/attenuated_admission_tests.rs').read_text()
out_domain = re.search(r'OUTPUT_SET_DOMAIN: &\[u8\] = b"([^"]*)"', src).group(1).replace('\\0', '\0').encode()
req_domain = re.search(r'REQUEST_DIGEST_DOMAIN: &\[u8\] = b"([^"]*)"', src).group(1).replace('\\0', '\0').encode()
for names, golden in ((['out'], '5aadee160983d4cbda395f623dee917c0ed67af797e6142d522209d267fbd248'), (['dev', 'out'], '37da46b8c8c74bf492cf7db06f9d45832615605e609bcea258ed70e5c9e22d08')):
    got = b3(out_domain + b''.join(fr(n.encode()) for n in sorted(names)))
    print('output_set_id', names, got, 'golden-in-test-matches:', got == golden, 'literal-present-in-test:', golden in tests)
js = re.search(r'const GOLDEN_REQUEST_JSON: &str = r#"(.*?)"#;', tests, re.S).group(1).encode()
want = re.search(r'const GOLDEN_REQUEST_DIGEST: &str = "([0-9a-f]{64})"', tests).group(1)
got = b3(req_domain + fr(b'builder-1') + fr(js))
print('request digest', got, 'golden-in-test-matches:', got == want, '| json bytes:', len(js), '| domain:', req_domain)
